description: When every address in `identity_ids` (comma-separated address ids, up to 10) is free between `after` and `before` (ISO 8601; default the next 7 days, 31 at most), in stretches at least `duration_minutes` long (default 30). For working hours pass `day_start` and `day_end` (`09:00`, `17:30`) and `skip_weekends: "true"`; they are read in `timezone`, or the first address’s calendar zone. Each slot has `start`/`end` in UTC and `local_start`/`local_end` in that zone — use the local ones when you tell a person. Busy means a timed event not cancelled or declined; tentative is busy, all-day events are not. It only covers these addresses’ own calendars, not anyone outside. It books nothing: propose a slot, then `create_calendar_event`.
name: find_free_time
title: When everybody is free
